verdict.rationale: Gazebo can run headless via the -s flag and offers a lightweight server-only package plus extensive CLI tools for introspection/control, which are building blocks that could enable CI-based simulation runs. However, there is no evidence of dedicated test frameworks, CI pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), automated regression-test tooling, or documented CI integration patterns. missing for 10: documented CI/regression-test workflows, test framework/harness integration, examples of automated pass/fail assertions on simulation runs.
